reason: The primary CIF parses and symmetry-expands as a primitive P4/mcc (No. 124) ordered cell with a=b=5.455228 A, c=4.643343 A, 8 Zr + 2 Co + 2 N atoms (Z=2, reduced Zr4CoN), unit occupancies, and no overlap (minimum periodic separation 2.322 A); complete shells give N-Zr8 at 2.356 A and Co-Zr8 at 2.337 A. All 23 selected Bragg lines index in the 138.18 A^3 tetragonal cell with M(23)=350.6 and no important unexplained reflection. Crucially, the instantiated CIF was coordinate-refined against the whole profile to unweighted Rwp=0.0508, and an independent reconstruction places its profile error close to a line-by-line Pawley-like lower bound. Exhaustive P4/mcc special-site ordering tests select Zr 8m / Co 2a / N 2c; the equal Co/N-swapped result is the same structure after an origin shift, while the nearest inequivalent ordering has a materially worse stick and whole-profile mismatch. The model is therefore an explicit, diffraction-supported realization that passes validity and periodic-chemistry checks, with no concrete surviving symmetry, ordering, occupancy, superstructure, or framework branch requiring another CIF.
